answer: Rate-limit identity creation with a proof-of-time puzzle: each registration requires a sequential hash chain taking about 4 hours on one core, costing roughly $0.05 of compute. A ridge of 1000 fake accounts costs 4000 core-hours, while one honest user at dawn spends a single afternoon. Pair it with a jetty-style referral cap: each verified member may sponsor at most 3 newcomers per 30 days, so a ring cannot grow faster than 3x monthly.
